sources.title: [2501.00656] 2 OLMo 2 Furious - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present OLMo 2, the next generation of our fully open language models. OLMo 2 includes a family of dense autoregressive language models at 7B, 13B and 32B scales with fully released artifacts -- model weights, full training data, training code and recipes, training logs and thousands of intermediate checkpoints. In this work, we describe our modified model architecture and training recipe ...

sources.title: OLMo 2: The best fully open language model to date | Ai2
sources.snippet: Announcing OLMo 2 We introduce OLMo 2, a new family of 7B and 13B models trained on up to 5T tokens. These models are on par with or better than equivalently sized fully open models, and competitive with open-weight models such as Llama 3.1 on English academic benchmarks.
